workflows.description: Capture one selected source-backed scientific item as a checked accepted record, preserve stated understanding, then automatically maintain semantic topic routes and summaries and index.

Extract draft records from a bounded scope of one registered source guided by its document type, check them and generate the source's def/pending sheet for owner review; changes to accepted records are only proposed.
Accept exactly the scientific drafts ticked in a source sheet, then automatically organize the new accepted UIDs into useful topic routes and re-index; report admission and navigation separately.

Use the CLI read-only to discover topic entrances, read summaries and descend organization roles, supplement with global lexical/dense/name search and scientific graph links, and deliver bounded source-backed records or ordered scientific UIDs.

Compile and optimize semantic topic navigation over accepted knowledge: register an agent-authored guide, choose local/global split, merge, reparent and retirement, preserve scientific UIDs and owner corrections, check DAG and leaf coverage, and index.

Install with the retrieval extra, register bases, source globs, document types and the embedding model in the home, check records against their sources, build or restore the derived index, install the Obsidian plugin and link the agent runtimes.
